methodology_note: Sachar Committee (2006), Chapter 8 section 2.1, from NSS 61st round (2004-05); all-India average MPCE by socio-religious category. Muslims Rs.635 vs the all-India average Rs.712, near SC/ST (Rs.520) and far below upper-caste 'Hindu General' households (Rs.1023); Muslim deprivation is sharpest in urban areas.
